kpi.outstandingHint: Issued and unpaid, all currencies shown separately

quotes.title: Quotes
quotes.description: Quotations for clients. Drafts can be edited; sent quotes are locked.
quotes.emptyDescription: Create a draft quote and add line items. Issuing assigns a number.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.description: Invoices, payments and replacements. Issued invoices are immutable.
invoices.emptyDescription: Create a draft invoice, or convert an accepted quote.

form.dueDateHint: Optional. If left empty, 30 days from the issue date.
form.validUntilHint: Optional. If left empty, 30 days from the issue date.
form.languageHint: Used for the covering email and the file name. The PDF itself is always issued in English and Arabic together.

items.empty: No line items. A document needs at least one line before it can be issued.

actions.issueHint: Issuing assigns the next number and locks the document. Afterwards only status, payments and the PDF can change.
actions.issueNeedsItems: Add at least one line item before issuing.
actions.voidHint: Voiding keeps the number and the record. Issue a replacement to correct the invoice.
actions.convertHint: Copies the header and line items into a draft invoice linked to this quote.
actions.replaceHint: Creates a new draft that copies this void invoice and refers back to it. Correct it, then issue it.
actions.sendHint: Emails the client's primary contact a link to the client portal and marks the invoice as sent.
actions.deleteConfirm: Delete this draft? This cannot be undone.
actions.voidQuoteHint: Voiding keeps the number and the record. Duplicate the quote to prepare a corrected draft.

payment.title: Payments
payment.removeHint: Use this only for a payment recorded by mistake. The balance and status of the invoice are recalculated, and the removal is kept in the audit log.

immutable.title: This document is locked
immutable.invoice: Issued invoices cannot be edited. To correct it, void this invoice and issue a replacement.
immutable.quote: Sent quotes cannot be edited. Void it and create a new quote, or duplicate it into a fresh draft.

notFound.title: Document not found
notFound.description: It may have been deleted, or you do not have access to it.
